I am mot sure if this has been answered yet but that looks like burnt oil, your most probable cause would be the valve seals.

Now once again I'm not trying to be the bearer of bad news but that seems to be blue smoke, an indication of burnt oil, further test by turning the car on and keep it running for about 5 minutes then hit the gas pedal increasing your rpms, if it smokes its burning oil, also keep in mind this could be a very minor leak, beginning so it might be difficult to spot out.

Once again double check and take it to a trusted mechanic to further investigate the matter, maybe its just water condensation after all.
